summary: @servicetitan/marketing-integration-widgets 1.0.45 ships preinstall Bun-runtime dropper executing obfuscated payload
details: Version 1.0.45 of this React widget library ships a preinstall dropper chain. package.json declares `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727 KB single-line Bun-bundled blob (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) using rotated string-array indirection (functions `WV8StW`, `n7gIxM`, decoder `hc1jfK9`) — an opaque payload whose contents cannot be reviewed without executing it. Bun is not used to build or serve the advertised widget library; its sole role is to execute this bundled blob at install time, evading Node-based inspection tooling. package.json declares `"files": ["dist", "src"]`, but setup.mjs and math_init.js are shipped at the tarball root outside the declared allowlist — the payload was not part of the author's declared surface, consistent with an out-of-band publish (compromised publish token) rather than a normal author release. `npm install` of this version executes attacker-controlled code on the installer's machine before any application code runs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
